setupPage.aBodyThatHoldsA: A body that holds a private key of any kind is refused whole, and nothing of it is kept.

setupPage.certificatesOnPrivateNetworksAre: Certificates on private networks are sent by a collector in that network.
setupPage.warningsComeAtTheThresholds: Warnings come at the thresholds in the header of Certificates, once per crossing: GET /api/v1/expiring lists them, and /metrics has openasy_certificates_expiring for alerts.
